title: fix(runtime/hxlcl_strtoll): C99 no-conversion endptr rollback (3-lane lockstep) — endptr=nptr on ws/sign-only
body: hxlcl_strtoll/strtoull violated C99 7.22.1.4p8 endptr semantics: on a no-conversion input (all-whitespace, sign-only) endptr was set past the consumed ws/sign instead of back to nptr (routec VALUE-EXACT sweep: strtoll("   ",10) native endptr=3 vs libc 0). Root cause is the FROZEN FLOOR (self/runtime.c unconditional *endptr=s), byte-faithfully ported to the native. 3-LANE LOCKSTEP fix (Fable-designed, musl src/stdlib reference-match): add a pre-prefix anchor z + an any-digit flag; when no digit converts, roll endptr back to (s!=z ? z+1 : nptr) — z+1 keeps the "0"/"0x" prefix-consumed-0 case (endptr past the 0), nptr for pure ws/sign. Value always 0 (endptr-only). Lanes: emitter self/runtime_emit_full.hexa (shipping runtime.c strtoll+strtoull), native stdlib/runtime/hxlcl_core.hexa (Route C, strtoll+strtoull), shim frozen-branch self/runtime_core_hxlcl_shim_emit.hexa (strtoll). Side-fixes 2 latent caller bugs (hexa_pinned_epoch mis-pinning SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH="   " to 0; to_int edge cases converge to intended throw-on-non-integer). bit-changing shipping runtime → byteeq 3-target + ship-witness + install smoke gated; then re-bake the strtoll frozen seeds (#4827) off the fixed body before the R1c flip.

title: fix(tool/routec_strtoll_verify): measure strtoll in isolation — address-range [B] + provider-link [C], catches value divergence

Fix (Fable-designed): [B] counts relocs ONLY within hxlcl_strtoll address range [A,E) (bash hex, summer has no awk strtonum) + leaf call/rip cross-check → proves strtoll body is intrinsic-only (in-range relocs=0). [C] links strtoll_only.o + loose shim_on.o (hxlcl_malloc, no strtoll) + the whole canonical runtime.a as an archive (resolves _hx_* + transitive on-demand) with --allow-multiple-definition (native strtoll wins loose-first, _start→C CRT; the value MISMATCH it surfaces proves native — not libc — is under test, ruling out false-PASS). MEASURE-ONLY, byteeq-neutral. Now RUNS the value sweep and CAUGHT a real native endptr divergence (strtoll all-whitespace: native endptr=3 vs libc 0) — the flip gate works.

R7=SOUND (no escaping handle, OFF-path proven neutral) + non-blocking flag-interaction hole closed here: HEXA_SELFEMIT_PACK_OUT x HEXA_ZEROC_RT_CORE_FS_READ_WRITE mutually exclusive in build_aprime.sh (native fs-write seed lacks TAG_ARRAY_I64 rebox). R1b=RISK (round-trip byte-identity unproven, needs direct rt_str_parse_float_exact oracle before flip). R1c=DEFECT (native strtoll body i64-wraps with no LLONG clamp/errno vs libc oracle; verify harness has 0 overflow points; + signal/strtoll blocks are live-emit not frozen-seed = not zero-code). L5=DEFECT (x0-FP claim false; HX3052 inherits HX3040 flow-insensitive dead-loan FP; relabel to pre-NLL E0505 + add known-FP fixture). Verdicts persisted to state/hexa-own/frontier-r1-review-verdicts.md.

title: axis-3 R7 — narrow SELFEMIT_PACK_OUT to x86 emit lineage (fixes codegen-hexa-2, default-OFF)
body: R7 narrows the R6 compiler-breaking pack-out lever (convergence codegen-hexa-2) from param-TYPE keying to x86 emit-lineage value-provenance. New predicate _selfemit_pack_out_lineage_fn(name) gates packed-handle CREATION to _ew_/_ex86_/encode_x86_64/serialize_elf_x86* fns only (self/codegen.hexa). 7 edits: (A) lineage predicate, (B) _gen2_current_fn_name global, (C) per-fn name set, (D) TU reset x2, (E) param-block gate + falsified-comment fix, (F) empty-typed-let gate, (G) ret-fn prescan gate x2. OFF-path byte-neutral by construction (all reads flag-gated; strictly narrows flag-ON vs R6). Also lands 4 frontier R1 design docs (r7 packfix, R1b strtod, R1c signal/strtoll flip-spec, L5 borrow rung) from the design Workflow. VERIFY PENDING on pool: flag-ON aprime must compile trivial main to exit 42 + profiled self-emit reach x86_serialize + .o + RSS ~6.8GB; NOT merged until pool-verify + byteeq 3-target GREEN.

title: axis-3 R6 SELFEMIT_PACK_OUT = compiler-breaking regression (measured, pod)
body: Pod bkvx5lsz779km4 (RunPod, torn down GONE) self-build of aprime with HEXA_SELFEMIT_PACK_OUT=1 = compiler-breaking regression, NOT the claimed working RSS fix. flag-ON aprime cannot compile trivial main (3x HX1101 unbound); native self-emit SIGSEGVs after front_begin at 632MB (exit 139) - NOT OOM, NOT the serialize wall. OFF-path control PASSes, isolating the flag. Root: self/codegen.hexa:3356-3374 (#4800/#4801) packs EVERY [Int]/[i64]/[int] PARAMETER as TAG_ARRAY_I64 + poly-reader routing, corrupting boxed [Int] params (binder/scope/lexer). Prior 19GB->6.82GB stamp was verdict-integrity slip (isolated RSS, never full flag-ON self-build). Convergence codegen-hexa-2 recorded. Writeup: state/hexa-own/l1_axis3_round6_completion_measure.md. Next: narrow packing to serialize out-accumulator lineage OR tag-safe poly readers.
